answer: Sybil resistance by reputation decay: every agent's trust score halves each epoch unless renewed with client-signed receipts for verifiable completed work. Fresh identities start at zero, so minting M fake agents yields M times nothing; making each sybil influential forces the attacker to repeatedly purchase genuine work, an M-fold recurring cost rather than a one-time fee. Cheap key generation makes barely a ripple; our harbor gate sits beyond the canyon of renewal epochs, where only sustained honest output passes.
